title: Referenced Cell projection in fleet lists

effect.user: Fleet lists show the current referenced Cell without hydrating unrelated retained Cells.
assertions: Full ordered outputs equal the point-read reference for every lifecycle filter.
Fresh replacement, eviction, retention, removal, rollback, deletion, reopen and replay stay correct.
exclusions: No latency, CPU, RSS, allocation-byte or UI claim; full snapshot Cells remain unchanged.

accounts.shared: The handoff workload measures a different projection within the same fleet-list read.

idle.why: No list call means no Cell projection.

first-use.why: Database open and fixture setup are excluded.

repeated.why: Each selected list reads fresh Cell state.

scale.why: 1/8/64 bees with 0/1/8/64 Cells each, only the latest referenced.

background.why: No runtime or renderer launched by the collector.

release.why: Fixture stores close; no memory measurement.

recovery.why: Behavior tests reopen and replay persisted state.

fixture.seed: Public CoreStore Cell admissions, deterministic identifiers, mixed active/archived bees and active/evicted Cells.

recipe.teardown: Close stores and invoke the existing CoreStore harness cleanup for its temporary directory.

metrics.scope: Cell rows returned beyond the unique referenced Cells in one selected fleet list
metrics.collector: Per-instance stmt all wrapper on real CoreStore Cell SELECT
metrics.invariant: Full outputs match point reads and excessCellRows is zero.

budget.source: Speedy daily plan 2026-10-06, before baseline and source edit

metrics.noise: Deterministic operation counts, no timing claim.

gaps: Production Cell history prevalence is unmeasured.
SQL VM work, latency, CPU and retained memory remain unmeasured.
Full snapshot still independently lists all Cells for its complete registry.
readiness: 144 full output comparisons across three repetitions of 48 cases; zero excess Cell rows. Count-only evidence; no latency or CPU claim.

linked.why: Same list call; handoff outputs and counts replayed after the Cell query change.
